description: Chatbot concept for a smart kitchen. I made it in one day, as a challenge during my internship at a design agency.
credit: The robot mascot is from Vic Bell’s Blink Bot.

hero.alt: The chatbot on a tilted phone: the bot greets the user, suggests egg noodles, then three other dishes, opens the meatloaf recipe and asks when to serve it

conversation.title: The conversation
description: You tell the bot what you want to eat by typing, by voice, or with the quick buttons for vegetables, pasta and wine. The bot offers one dish with its cook time and a side to go with it. If you turn it down, it shows three more.
After you open a recipe and tap Cook it, the bot asks when to serve the dish, and you pick the time.
